about: Labelled tickets for the generated sample context (tests/sample_context.py). 'expand' simulates the skill's model step and was written from the ticket alone, without looking up the real function names. Cases marked -oov use words outside the built-in synonym list on purpose.

cases.ticket: Hide all but the last four digits of a customer account number before logging
Debtor account numbers must be unreadable in the log lines, apart from the tail end
Obscure customer email addresses on the statements screen
Show balances as pounds and pence on the statement email
Display a pence value as GBP in the account card component
Calls to the payment gateway fail intermittently, retry them
Keep re-sending to the gateway when it hiccups, waiting a bit longer each time
Work out the settlement date skipping weekends and bank holidays
When will funds land if a transfer is sent on the Friday before Christmas?
cases.expand: land=settlement,settle,business day,working day; christmas=holiday,bank holiday; friday=weekend,weekday; add_business_days, next_working_day
